# 2 Baruch Chapter 86 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Baruch's Letters
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 86:1 — command to read the letter

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "I-command-you that-when-you-have-received-this-letter, you-read-it-in-your-assemblies with-care" |
| LOGOS | "I command you that when you have received this letter, you read it in your assemblies with care" |
| PNEUMA | "I instruct you: when you receive this letter, read it carefully in your assemblies" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. 'Command' (Syriac: paqed) is the authoritative term used throughout 2 Baruch for prophetic/authoritative instruction; PNEUMA's 'instruct' weakens the authoritative register.

---

## 86:2 — mutual remembrance formula

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "remember-me through-it, even-as-I-remember-you through-it" |
| LOGOS | "remember me through it, even as I remember you through it" |
| PNEUMA | "Remember me through it, just as I remember you through it" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. The mutual remembrance formula ('even as') preserves the Syriac aykanna d-ana dakar ana lkhon; PNEUMA's 'just as' is essentially equivalent but LOGOS is more consistently formal.

---
